enunciado: Show that two variables can refer to the same object (aliasing), that == compares identity unless the class defines equals, and how to use null safely with != and ??.
objetivos: Understand that a class variable holds a reference
pistas: Assigning an object to another variable does NOT copy it.
Without equals, two objects with the same data are different for ==.
Before using a reference that may be null, compare it with null.
